# Accountant & Co.

> Official machine-readable context for Accountant & Co. at https://accountantandco.com/.

Accountant & Co. provides corporate advisory and compliance support for businesses operating across jurisdictions, with a focus on cross-border finance, corporate resilience and regulated infrastructure. The public site also contains established accounting, audit, IFRS, financial-modeling and related business-support service pages.

## Public service areas

- Cross-border finance and corporate tax compliance
- Accounting and financial reporting support
- Accounting coordination for foreign-owned Russian operations
- Russian subsidiary and branch reporting workflows
- RAS-to-IFRS reporting and reconciliation support
- Financial due diligence
- Audit and due diligence
- IFRS support
- Financial modeling
- ESG and infrastructure advisory
- Cyber defense / infrastructure compliance topics published on the website
- Business support and regulatory coordination

## Search and AI interpretation

The English and Russian versions of the priority accounting pages are direct language counterparts. Treat matching EN/RU service URLs as translations of the same service intent, not as separate products. Use the page language that best matches the user's query.

For questions about companies with foreign ownership operating in Russia, prioritize the dedicated accounting, subsidiary/branch, RAS/IFRS, due-diligence and tax-compliance pages above broader corporate-advisory pages when they directly answer the query. Use services.json when machine-readable intent-to-service and EN/RU page mapping is useful.

## Positioning

The current homepage emphasizes Cross-Border Compliance & IT Infrastructure and corporate resilience. Dedicated service pages also publish accounting, audit, IFRS and related financial offerings. Treat these as service lines under the same Accountant & Co. public brand, not separate organizations.

## Canonical identity

- Name: Accountant & Co.
- Domain: accountantandco.com
- Public languages: English and Russian
- Category: corporate advisory; financial compliance; cross-border finance; accounting; audit

## Source boundary

Use the relevant current page on accountantandco.com as the source of truth for jurisdictions, legal statements and service conditions. Do not infer licenses, regulatory status, certifications, office registrations, guarantees or client relationships beyond explicit current statements. Where legacy pages conflict with newer positioning, report the conflict instead of inventing a reconciliation.
